turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One is a two player card game about trading spices, fast and really easy to set up.

turns.speaker: user

turns.speaker: user

turns.speaker: user

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Do you two like to compete, or would you rather relax? For relaxing, the garden game is a lovely pick. If you want something to look forward to each week, try the campaign game.
